**Finding: deviation (ASSIGN)**

- **§ 15.6 Assignment (p0814–p0816)** is fine: mutual consent requirement with an express carve-out letting PB assign to Affiliates or to a successor in a merger, stock sale or sale of substantially all assets (including by operation of law) — this meets the preferred position on Customer assignment. No redline taken there.
- **§ 14.2.6 (p0765)** fails: a Change of Control of PB (broadly defined at p0036–p0037 — 50% voting-power change or sale of the Product business) gives SFJ a **sole-discretion right to terminate the whole Agreement** plus an accelerated payment of 150% of Development Costs. That is walk-away territory under the rule, and PB's optional Change of Control Buy-Out (§ 6.7.2, p0530) does not cure it since it is PB's separate election.

Redline validated (ok:true) and submitted: SFJ's change-of-control termination right and the 150% payment are deleted, PB's notice obligation and its continuing development/Approval Payment obligations (p0766) are preserved, with a conforming cross-reference fix.
